integrated_tech_stack.value: Multi-input capture layer: phone, flatbed/autofeed scanner, cert lookup, batch upload and hardware-ingestion events, with standardized front/back image capture.

Canonical inventory control plane with immutable card identity, variant/parallel, condition, grade/certification, quantity, location, cost basis and channel-SKU mappings; adapter-based sync for eBay, Shopify, TCGplayer, Whatnot, Cardmarket and POS.

Explainable computer-vision decision layer: card localization, front/back and type recognition, identity candidates, image-quality gate, centering, corners, edges, surface, autograph and counterfeit-risk outputs.
Evidence/report layer inspired by DIG/TCGrader/EDGE: original and rectified images, defect coordinates, subgrades, confidence, model version, human corrections and signed/shareable report.
Provenance-aware comp service: retain source marketplace, sale timestamp, grade/raw state, fees/shipping normalization and confidence rather than only a single market price.
Rules and safety engine for seller templates, grade/sport/set/player/value conditions, margins, floors, rounding and approval thresholds, with a complete change log and replay.
Operational modules beyond listing: buylist/trade-in, card-show POS with offline queue, consignment intake, vault/fulfillment handoff, store credit, portfolio and set-completion views.
Migration/export contract with versioned CSV/JSON mappings, validation preview, byte-stable exports, reversible imports and dead-letter/error review.

gsn_cards_product_blueprint.competitive_advantages: GSN Cards should not compete only on another fast scanner. The defensible advantage is an evidence-first operating system for cards: (1) every match produces candidate identities, field-level confidence, source images and a human correction trail; (2) every price carries comp provenance, time, grade/raw normalization, fees and uncertainty; (3) every AI condition result is explicitly pre-grade/risk guidance rather than counterfeit-proof certification, with quality gates and escalation; (4) every marketplace write is idempotent, replayable and visible in a reconciliation ledger, avoiding the opaque sync semantics left undisclosed by the leading multi-channel products; (5) one graph joins collector portfolio, dealer inventory, show POS, buylist, consignment, vault/fulfillment and set completion; (6) outlier price changes and low-confidence identities use approval workflows rather than silent automation; and (7) versioned imports/exports let users leave without data lock-in. This combines the capture/listing strengths of Card Dealer Pro, TCG Automate and CardLuma; the data/retention patterns of Card Ladder, Collectr and PSA Set Registry; the report transparency of TAG, EDGE and TCGrader; the specialist API decomposition disclosed by Ximilar; and the operational breadth of TCG Sync, BinderPOS, Storepass, COMC and ShipMyCards. Claims of accuracy, scale and AI capability should be benchmarked publicly per game and image condition, because the fetched sources generally do not disclose test sets, calibration, model architecture, OAuth scopes, rate limits or failure behavior.
